title: Solibao potato (BSU Po4): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Solibao potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Solibao potato is a potato variety from BSU NPRCRTC. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Solibao is a registered potato variety, also sold or known as BSU Po4 or Solibao (BSU Po4). It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1997 as NSIC 1997 Po 05. It comes from BSU NPRCRTC. It takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest, with 24.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for BSU Po4 or Solibao (BSU Po4), this is the same potato. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

items: **Days to harvest:** 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 24.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Solibao potato takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest. That is 6.5 days longer than the average of the 11 potato varieties with a day count, 103.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 24.4 t/ha beats the average of its group, 21.79. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 100 to 120 days.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [late blight](/diseases/late-blight).

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have cream flesh and brownish skin. Dry matter is 18.21 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Cream flesh, brownish skin, oblong oval tubers, shallow eyes, dry matter about 18 percent.
Resistant to late blight and peach scale insect.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: released alongside Igorota by BSU as a highland fries, chips and table potato. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Solibao potato

It suits highland areas. Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items.q: Is BSU Po4 the same as Solibao?
items.a: Yes. BSU Po4 is another name for Solibao, registered as NSIC 1997 Po 05. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 24.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Solibao?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
